messages:
anna: hi team — CredoHealth says their new org shows up in Console after SSO but there is no API token under the project. demo in ~3h, they need a token surfaced in the prod project. customer: alice@credohealth.com, tenant=tn-98765, project=proj-credo-prod-1

jason: thanks anna. can you paste tenant + project + any sso email you have so i can trace?

anna: tenant=tn-98765 project=proj-credo-prod-1 user=alice@credohealth.com. they said service account was created during onboarding but the Console token list is empty.

devon: i'll pull provisioning logs. @provisioner-bot run last_provision tn-98765

provisioner-bot: Provisioner run 2026-03-17T15:22Z: sa 'sa-credo' created -> project proj-credo-prod-1. Token issuance step status: SKIPPED (existing token found scoped to proj-credo-test).

ivan: that suggests the token exists but got bound to the test project. quick check endpoint: 
```
GET /internal/keys?tenant=tn-98765&service_account=sa-credo
```
returns:
```
[{"token_id":"tok-aaa","bound_project":"proj-credo-test","created_by":"provisioner"}]
```

jason: so token tok-aaa exists in prod org but wrong project. provisioning likely re-used SA from earlier test run. we can't rebind tok-aaa to prod (tokens are immutable w.r.t project). we should create a new token for prod and surface it in Console.

devon: i can create a new token quickly. steps:
1) create_token --sa sa-credo --project proj-credo-prod-1 --scope default
2) record secret in secure storage and surface to Console on project view

anna: customer policy says no secrets sent in chat. they want the token visible in the Console when they log in with SSO. can we ensure the new token shows up in project view?

ivan: Console filters tokens by token.project_id. if we create token with project_id=proj-credo-prod-1 and created_by=provisioner, it will show up. root cause: provisioning flow missed passing project_id into token create call when reuse_path was hit. i'll open a fix.

jason: for immediate unblock, propose: devon creates new token with correct project and uploads it to secure-delivery so Console can index it, or we create token directly via internal API so it's bound correctly. anna, confirm customer delivery preference?

anna: they prefer Console surfacing. please create token under prod and trigger Console indexing. also do not send secret in chat. i'll tell them to re-login and check Tokens in project settings.

provisioner-bot: Action log: created new token tok-bbb for sa-credo -> proj-credo-prod-1 at 2026-03-17T16:05Z by devon. Orphan token tok-aaa located in proj-credo-test (will be marked for deletion after 24h if no objections).

devon: created tok-bbb and kicked Console index job. internal link: https://internal.redwood/secure/credo/12345 (secure delivery entry, access-controlled). i'll not paste secret here.

anna: sending note to customer now with instructions: log in via SSO -> Project "credo-prod-1" -> Settings -> Tokens. will follow up if they can't find it.

ivan: i'll open PR #2567 to ensure project_id always flows into create_token during onboarding and add an e2e test that simulates a reuse_path to prevent this regression.

jason: thanks all — great triage. :thumbsup:
